about_the_game:
This Once Upon a Time Pack includes 7 furniture items, 15 clothing items, 8 wigs, 1 mount, and 1 pet.

If you want to live in a fairytale, then this is the pack for you! The Once Upon a Time Pack has 30 fairytale-inspired outfits and furniture items available for you to customize your characters and decorate your homes, sheds, and farms.

Pack includes:
  • Once Upon a Time Furniture Set: Once Upon a Time Bed, Once Upon a Time Wardrobe, Once Upon a Time Ever Rose, Once Upon a Time Rug, Once Upon a Time Couch, Once Upon a Time Dark Wardrobe, and Once Upon a Time Dark Couch
  • Prince Outfit Set: Brown Prince Wig, Blonde Prince Wig, Red Prince Shirt, Blue Prince Shirt, Prince Charming Pants
  • Golden King Outfit Set: Brown King Wig, Golden King Shirt, Golden King Pants
  • Teal King Outfit Set: Black King Wig, Teal King Shirt, Teal King Pants
  • Golden Princess Outfit Set: Golden Princess Wig, Golden Princess Dress, Golden Princess Gloves
  • Diamond Princess Outfit Set: Diamond Princess Wig, Diamond Princess Dress, Diamond Princess Gloves
  • Quartz Princess Outfit Set: Quartz Princess Wig, Quartz Princess Dress, Quartz Princess Gloves
  • Amethyst Princess Outfit Set: Amethyst Princess Wig, Amethyst Princess Dress, Amethyst Princess Gloves
  • Fairytale Carriage Mount
  • Bippity, the Fairy Pet
